label: lte-native-capture-20261019-01
method: Configured conditional DMRS fit, both slots, six RBs starting at 13; native input antenna 0, int16 I/Q, 15.36 MS/s, normal CP, cell 0, group hopping enabled, sequence hopping disabled, group assignment 0, common cyclic shift 2 and DCI cyclic shift 0. Remove +7.5 kHz UL offset, estimate residual CFO from prefix with 8-sample edge trims, allow +/-8-sample linear phase/delay. No payload decoder.
limits: Checks sample-buffer consistency with the known working eNodeB context; not independent payload/CRC decoding, absolute SFN validation or a demonstrated failed-session cause. Periodic reference signals alone cannot exclude a whole-frame buffer lag. CFO values are prefix-based estimates after the assumed UL offset correction, not calibrated oscillator error. Raw trace includes another temporary RNTI NACK, which is excluded from this connected-UE working reference.
